name: security-sse-event-authorization-review
intent: Server-Sent Events stream identity and per-event resource filtering
artifacts: EventSource auth mechanism, stream selection, Last-Event-ID handling, broker subscription and event serializer.
trace: Follow requester identity into channel/cursor selection and each emitted object. Check replay/resume without replacing current authorization with a cursor capability by accident.
experiment: Use two owned streams and synthetic events; compare normal subscribe/resume with a foreign cursor/channel and a revoked membership.
disproof: A kept-alive response or guessed channel name is not cross-user event exposure; prove an unauthorized synthetic event is delivered.
repair: Bind stream/cursor access to current policy and verify entitled resume plus restricted event exclusion.
branch_decisions: Last-Event-ID can be a resume position rather than a bearer credential. Reapply the current actor/resource filter to replayed events. Distinguish broker events already authorized and buffered before revocation from new events, and do not equate HTTP stream establishment with delivery of protected data.
